title: Software Engineer — Full Stack
description:
Build and ship the web and backend applications we deliver for clients — from first scaffold through production support.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Design, build and maintain web applications and APIs end to end
* Work directly with clients to turn requirements into something shippable
* Review teammates’ code and keep the quality bar steady across projects
* Support what you ship — you are close to production, not shielded from it


 What we are looking for
   

  

* Solid JavaScript/TypeScript, plus one of React, Node.js, Python or Java
* Comfortable with relational databases and REST or GraphQL APIs
* You can explain a technical trade\\-off to someone non\\-technical
* You have worked in, or want to work in, a small team with wide scope


 Run the cloud and on\\-premise infrastructure behind our client engagements, and the automation that keeps it boring.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Provision and operate infrastructure across AWS, Azure or GCP
* Build CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure\\-as\\-code that other engineers rely on
* Set up monitoring and alerting, and respond when it fires
* Harden systems and help clients meet their security and compliance obligations


 What we are looking for
   

  

* Hands\\-on with Linux, containers and at least one major cloud provider
* Terraform, Ansible or equivalent infrastructure\\-as\\-code experience
* Kubernetes in production, or a clear appetite to get there
* You automate the thing rather than documenting how to do it manually


 Own quality across our delivery work — build the automated coverage that lets us ship often without holding our breath.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Write and maintain automated test suites for web and API layers
* Build testing into CI so failures surface before review, not after release
* Do exploratory testing on new features and write up what you find clearly
* Work with engineers on testability rather than inspecting quality in at the end


 What we are looking for
   

  

* Experience with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium or similar
* You can write code, not just click through test cases
* API testing, and a working understanding of how the system fits together
* A bug report from you tells the engineer exactly how to reproduce it


 Find and qualify the organisations we should be talking to, and open the conversation properly.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Identify and research prospective clients across our service lines
* Run first conversations — understand the problem before pitching anything
* Build and maintain the pipeline, and keep it honest
* Work with the delivery team on proposals and scoping


 What we are looking for
   

  

* B2B business development experience, ideally in IT or software services
* You can hold a credible conversation about technology without overselling
* Clear written English — much of this job is email
* Comfortable being measured on pipeline quality, not just activity


 Take qualified opportunities through to signature, then keep those client relationships healthy and growing.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Own opportunities from qualification through proposal, negotiation and close
* Act as the commercial point of contact for existing accounts
* Spot where an existing client would genuinely benefit from more of our help
* Keep forecasting accurate — we would rather know early than be surprised


 What we are looking for
   

  

* Track record closing B2B services deals, ideally in IT or consulting
* You are comfortable with longer, consultative sales cycles
* You keep commitments to clients even when it is inconvenient
* Experience with a CRM and a disciplined approach to keeping it current

title: GTM Engineer, India
description:
**IMPORTANT: PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING** 




  






 To be considered, you must follow the How to Apply instructions at the end of this job description and complete the Signalmash application form.
 




  






 Applications that do not include the completed form will not be reviewed. Automated or bulk applications that do not follow these instructions will be disregarded.
 




  





 About Signalmash
 


 Signalmash operates a cloud communications platform that enables businesses to manage and deliver RCS, SMS, and MMS messaging through carrier and technology\\-provider integrations. The platform includes customer onboarding, messaging APIs, routing, compliance, vendor integrations, usage tracking, and billing.
 




  






 As we scale our go\\-to\\-market motion, we are adding an India\\-based GTM Engineer to design, build, and operate the systems that power our outbound revenue engine.
 




  





 The Role
 


 The GTM Engineer will own the machinery of outbound: the systems that find the right companies, enrich and score them, reach them across email and LinkedIn with strong deliverability, and hand qualified conversations to our sales team with full context.
 




  






 This is an engineering role that serves sales — not a marketing role with tools. You will treat pipeline generation as a system: instrumented, tested, and improved every week. You will work directly with US leadership, and what you build will be the operating system our SDRs run on.
 




  






 This is a hands\\-on builder position. The successful candidate must be comfortable wiring APIs and webhooks, debugging a failing workflow at the data level, and proving — with numbers — that a campaign works before scaling it.
 




  





 Key Responsibilities
 
* Build and operate end\\-to\\-end outbound systems: ICP definition, list building, enrichment waterfalls, email verification, segmentation, and signal\\-based prospecting (hiring, funding, tech\\-stack, and intent signals).
* Own cold\\-email infrastructure: domains, mailboxes, warmup, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, sender rotation, inbox\\-placement monitoring, and send\\-volume discipline.
* Orchestrate multi\\-channel sequences across email and LinkedIn with personalization that comes from data, not templates.
* Keep the CRM the single source of truth: lead routing, deduplication, lifecycle stages, reply classification, meeting handoffs, and closed\\-loop reporting so every campaign's results feed the next one.
* Apply AI as a working tool, not a buzzword: LLM\\-driven research, personalization, scoring, and reply triage with human judgment gates; build agents and workflows with tools such as Claude Code where they beat manual work.
* Instrument everything: replies, meetings, and pipeline by segment and message; kill what does not work quickly and scale what does.
* Arm SDRs and leadership with clean lists, account briefs, and dashboards; document systems so they outlive any single tool.



 Required Experience
 
* 2\\+ years building outbound/GTM systems hands\\-on (in\\-house or agency), with real artifacts you can walk through — workflows, campaigns, dashboards. We will ask to see them.
* Working proficiency across the modern GTM stack: Clay or equivalent; Apollo/ZoomInfo\\-class data sources; Smartlead/Instantly\\-class sequencers; n8n/Make/Zapier; and a CRM such as HubSpot.
* Demonstrated deliverability knowledge: you have set up domains and mailboxes, managed warmup, and kept campaigns out of spam at real volume.
* Verified use of AI in your work — not "AI\\-curious": prompts, agents, enrichment, or scoring systems you personally built and can demonstrate.
* Comfort with APIs, webhooks, and light scripting (JavaScript or Python) to connect what no\\-code cannot.
* Data discipline: clean lists, deduplication, verified contacts, and accurate attribution.
* Strong written English — your messaging will be read by US buyers.
* Based in India with working\\-hours overlap into the US morning (approximately 6:30–11:30 PM IST as needed).



 Preferred Experience
 
* Messaging or communications industry exposure: CPaaS, SMS/RCS/WhatsApp, contact center, VoIP/SIP, or telecom\\-adjacent SaaS.
* Prospecting into the US market.
* LinkedIn automation operated safely (HeyReach or similar) without burning accounts.
* Claude Code, MCP, or agent frameworks used in production workflows.
* Accountability for outcomes: you have owned a system end to end and been measured on meetings booked, not activity.



 Location
 


 The position is based in India and may initially be remote. Signalmash is evaluating an engineering office in Kochi during 2026\\-2027\\. Candidates should be open to relocating to Kochi if an office is established.
 




  





 How to Apply
 


 Please complete the Signalmash application form:
 




  





 https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScZmO4\\-GO3CuAuOuYl5AhiHQJjKiHkEL0tS3MU5PRqxdWzGMA/viewform?usp\\=dialog
 



  






 You can upload your resume directly through the form. You may also upload an optional two\\-to\\-three\\-minute video or audio introduction — or, strongly encouraged for this role, a short Loom walkthrough of an outbound system you personally built. Applications that include a walkthrough will receive priority review. Recording quality, accent, appearance, and background are not evaluated. We care about clarity, authenticity, thoughtfulness, and whether you actually built what your resume says you built.
 




  






 Applications without a completed Signalmash application form will not be reviewed.
